_doc: Home templates of the residential districts (Docs/Locations/Plan_ResidentialDistricts.md). Factions built from these are NEVER listed in initializeFactions: ResidenceUtility.CreateResidence instantiates one per generated home under a new ID (<districtID>_res_<n>) and links its mainExit room (or the district entry's linkRoomID) to a district attach room with a runtime floor door (hidden runtime exits). Authored households can count as one of these templates without being built from it (world.json initializeResidences, ResidenceUtility.AdoptResidence). isPublic false + showLockedFloors true = the player sees the home's floor button but generated-home access only opens its rooms to residents, visit passes (GrantVisitAccess), bookings there and the player's followers, without room-level flags on shared floor plans. A generated home is named after its leader by AssignResidence; nameOverwrite below is only the placeholder until then. Meals: a non-player faction hands out a fresh copy of an inventory item without depleting stock, so one bento covers every meal at furniture_marker_getmeal (hospital pattern).
